name: Daily Status with Dashboard Image
description: Full status briefing with AI-generated visual dashboard (adds ~60-90 seconds for image)

steps.llm_prompt:
Create a modern dark-themed status dashboard image showing these EXACT values:

WEATHER: ${temperature}°F, ${condition}, ${humidity}% humidity, ${wind_speed} mph wind
CRYPTO: Bitcoin $${btc_price} (${btc_change}% 24h), Solana $${sol_price} (${sol_change}% 24h)
STOCKS: TSLA $${tsla_price} (${tsla_change}%), Gold $${gold_price} (${gold_change}%)
SYSTEM: CPU ${cpu_percent}%, RAM ${memory_percent}%, Uptime ${uptime}
ALERTS: ${alert_count} pending, REMINDERS: ${reminder_count} upcoming

Style: Futuristic HUD design with neon accents, glowing elements, clean typography. Show all numbers clearly. Dark background with cyan/green/orange highlights. Make it look like a sci-fi command center display.

Create a clean, well-formatted status report. If an image was generated, include it at the top with: ![Status Dashboard](${image_ref})

IMPORTANT: Copy the stash:// reference EXACTLY as provided - do NOT modify the space ID format or dates.

Data to include:
Date: ${date} (${day_of_week})
Time: ${timestamp}

## Weather (${location}):
- Temperature: ${temperature}°F (feels like ${feels_like}°F)
- Condition: ${condition}
- Humidity: ${humidity}%
- Wind: ${wind_speed} mph

## Crypto:
- Bitcoin: $${btc_price} (${btc_change}% 24h)
- Solana: $${sol_price} (${sol_change}% 24h)

## Stocks:
- TSLA: $${tsla_price} (${tsla_change}% today)
- Gold: $${gold_price} (${gold_change}% today)

## Alerts: ${alert_count} pending
${alerts}

## Reminders: ${reminder_count} upcoming
${reminders}

## System Health:
- CPU: ${cpu_percent}%
- RAM: ${memory_percent}% (${memory_used_gb}/${memory_total_gb} GB)
- Uptime: ${uptime}

Format with emojis (🌤️ Weather, 📈 Crypto, 📊 Stocks, 🚨 Alerts, ⏰ Reminders, 💻 System). Add green/red indicators for changes.
steps.description: Create formatted canvas report with image

success_speech: Visual status report created with dashboard image. Check your canvas.
abort_speech: Couldn't complete the visual status report.
